profile_revalidation.reason: The Store/Index protocol uses only existing bounded scalar/control-flow semantics. Current 0.18 task/channel/process/filesystem/test facilities do not imply real runtime concurrency or networking, so no profile bump is claimed.

pressure_reclassification.note: Task/channel state-machine semantics exist; actual concurrent runtime execution remains absent.
Networking/socket effects are not required for the first local stdio service and remain unimplemented.
A bounded typed local request/response contract is admitted and called through a retained native protocol artifact; transport is still host-side.
Generic recursive protocol values remain absent; the first service contract is deliberately flat and bounded.
Filesystem/process effects are available in current profiles, but grant realization remains an external boundary.
Lifecycle, admission, freshness, release, and shutdown decisions now execute through the retained native protocol; actual runtime timers/concurrency remain external.
Clean current mncs-language builds agree with research on all former service-shaped cases; the ten historical WASM pins were removed and the differential canary remains.
